name: Alaska John
bio: Alaska John ran the 'Oyster Grotto' in Medora, where in January 1885 he put up a sign advertising fresh oysters 'blood raw, dead or alive.' A watch was raffled at his place in February 1885.

moments.label: Hung a new sign on the Oyster Grotto

mentions: Alaska John broke out in a fresh place yesterday and the following sign now adorns the front of the "Oyster Grotto:"  FRESH OYSTERS, BLOOD RAW, DEAD OR ALIVE.  "Toosh."
A fine watch was raffled for at Alaska John's Saturday night, the lucky man being Jim Hannigan.
